coupling: One fixed tail basis per rank shared across orders. All laws share the first-mode Gaussian draw within each trial. Other factors and the dense tail are independent. Ranks use independent streams.
interpretation: Finite-size observations, not a theorem probability. Quantile bands are trial distributions, not confidence intervals.

large_rank_extension.algorithm: Shared blocked contraction of actual product probes and an exact two-level-spectrum Woodbury error identity. No independent-tail surrogate.
large_rank_extension.old_observations: Original raw CSV preserved as a byte-for-byte prefix.

basis_orthogonality_errors_scope: Full spectral norms through rank 256; sampled-column checks in large-rank checkpoint files.
smallest_qr_rank_margin_scope: Only actual QR factorizations; large-rank Cholesky diagnostics are separate.
